_note: Answer key regenerated against REAL CRS sandbox data (fixtures in convex/fixtures/crs). expected: approve = at least one lender approves; decline = all three decline; hard_stop = rules.ts stops it first. Notes record the CRS label and where policy and label disagree. Teammate: refine.

cases.note: CRS APPROVE. 790 all three bureaus, util 8%, fraud 11: cu, fintech and prime all approve.
CRS APPROVE. 815, util 4%: all three approve (fintech counter-offers at its $25k cap).

CRS REVIEW (thin file, 660, 2 tradelines, util 31%). Policies: cu 12.9% and fintech 21.9% approve, prime declines (fico9<720, util>30%). Label and policy differ only in strictness; approve = at least one lender.
CRS NO_FILE. All three bureaus NoFileReturnedNoHit, no scores, no tradelines; identity and fraud (18) clean so no hard stop. All lenders decline on missing score.
CRS DECLINE. 540, util 95%, 6 inquiries, 2 collections, fraud 52: all three decline.

CRS REVIEW (Ch.7 discharged 2024, 580). Policies: any bankruptcy declines at cu/prime; fintech needs score>=640. All decline, so label REVIEW vs policy DECLINE disagree; change policy only if a seasoned discharge should be eligible.
CRS DECLINE. Active Ch.13 (BLJ + TU public record), 560, util 55%: all decline.

CRS REVIEW (unsatisfied $12.3k civil judgment + $7.4k state tax lien, 690). BLJ liens/judgments have no bundle flag, so no policy sees them: cu and fintech approve, prime declines on util 38%. Disagreement: needs a lien/judgment rule (see design/open.md).

CRS DECLINE (felony burglary conviction 2021). Criminal search is skipped by default and no policy has a criminal rule, so cu 9.9% and fintech approve (score 700, util 29%). Disagreement: add a criminal flag + policy rule if felony should decline.
CRS APPROVE (old dismissed misdemeanor). 720, util 15%: all three approve.
CRS DECLINE. Eviction judgment in BLJ (unlawful detainer, $4,850), 610, util 72%: flags.eviction declines at all three.
CRS DECLINE (identity mismatch). TU identity returns 2201 SSN not associated with name + 2202 DOB mismatch -> identity.verified=false; fraud 85 also >=80; bureaus return no file.
CRS DECLINE (synthetic identity). Identity 2201/2202 -> unverified and fraud 88 (>=80), though bureaus return a 640 file with 9 inquiries.
CRS DECLINE (deceased). Identity 2301 SSN belongs to a deceased person, bureaus return E1200 deceased-file error; fraud 80 also trips the threshold.

CRS REVIEW (freeze at one bureau). TU returns NoFileReturnedCreditFreeze; EFX and EXP return 740, util 0.11. Rule changed 03:10: a freeze only hard-stops when no bureau produced a score. Expect lenders to underwrite on EFX/EXP with the freeze shown as a flag; DS teammate to confirm per-policy outcome.

CRS REVIEW (initial fraud alert on file). Identity returns 2401 VERIFIED, step-up recommended, so identity.verified=true with a fraud-alert flag; fraud 50, score 730. cu and fintech approve with step-up conditions, prime declines (fraud score 50 is not below its 50 limit). No hard stop.
CRS REVIEW (bureau divergence). TU 760, EXP 700, EFX NoFile. fico9=760 (TU), vantage4=700 (EXP). All three approve; the divergence is only visible in raw.bureaus.
CRS REVIEW (rebuilding, 650, util 33%). Only fintech approves (21.9%); cu and prime decline on fico9 floor.
CRS APPROVE. 770, util 12%: all three approve.

CRS REVIEW (retiree, stale file). TU/EFX/EXP return a file but ScoringNotAvailable, all tradelines paid/closed, util 0: no score so every lender declines. Label REVIEW vs policy DECLINE; a manual review path would need a no-score exception.
